newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler October vehicle output up 10.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler October vehicle output up 10.1 pct.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said it produced 282,685 cars and trucks worldwide during the month of October, up 10.1 percent from the 256,734 units built during the same period last year.

Chrysler said its total car production for the month rose by 6.1 percent to 88,868 from 83,760 a year earlier. October truck output increased by 12 percent to 193,817 from 172,974 a year earlier, reflecting increased production of minivans and Jeep Grand Cherokees in Canada and Austria and Dodge pickup trucks in Mexico.

In the United States, Chrysler car production fell to 49,046 from 52,597 a year earlier, while U.S. truck production dipped to 117,690 from 119,968, partly due to the continuing production launch of the Dodge Dakota pickup truck.

In Canada, car production for the month rose to 26,656 units from 20,184, while truck production rose to 44,446 from 35,920. In Mexico, Chrysler's October car production rose to 13,166 from 10,979 a year ago, while truck production rose to 20,933 units from 13,67. In Graz, Austria, Chrysler built 10,748 Voyager mininvans and Jeep Grand Cherokee sport/utility vehicles during October, up from 3,415 a year earlier.
